reviews.text: My four-legged son fell ill in the middle of the night. I panicked and rushed to the clinic. Thank God I found an angel, a doctor who saved my dog's life. I will always be grateful for her life. Dr. Giovanna, thank you so much for your excellent work.
I highly recommend them!!! Professionalism and service that are worth it!
I would like to express my sincere gratitude; our animals were all very well cared for.

Structure and service leave much to be desired.
For the price charged for the services, I expected to find a clinic with a much better structure. In my opinion, the place is quite simple and seems to need more maintenance and improvements. Honestly, I didn't think the structure matched the prices charged.
Another point that bothered me a lot was the slowness of the service. Even in situations where you expect to be served more quickly, the process ends up being slow and poorly organized.
In addition, I felt a lack of clarity in the information provided by the staff. Many times it is not very clear what is being done, what the procedures are, what prices are being charged and exactly what you are paying for.
I understand that a veterinary clinic has costs and that certain procedures can be expensive, but considering the prices charged, I believe that the establishment should offer a much better structure, organization and communication.
Terrible service, I do not recommend it.

Excellent professionals!!! Very well-structured place!!!
Special thanks to doctors Jaqueline and Milene who were very attentive and took care of my Katy with great affection.

The blood test was very quick and accurate thanks to the skill of Dr. Jaqueline who, in the blink of an eye, collected the sample and Katy didn't even feel it.

I have nothing but praise for the veterinary hospital! If I could, I would give it 1,000 stars! Veterinarian Bartira is simply incredible, an extremely competent and attentive professional, and an excellent surgeon. I have complete trust in her and the entire team to care for my dogs.

The environment is very clean, organized, and pleasant, conveying a sense of peace and security. You can feel the affection and care everyone has for the animals. The entire team is very attentive, careful, and treats the animals with great respect and love.

The consultation room is spacious, exams are performed on-site, and the hospitalization area is also very good, which brings even more peace of mind when we need that kind of care.

The veterinarians are very attentive and careful, always explaining everything and demonstrating genuine concern for the animals' well-being.

I am very grateful to be able to count on such a competent and humane team. I wholeheartedly recommend them! ❤️🐾
Congratulations on the work, structure, and professionalism.
The clinic was very good, I liked it.
Excellent

My dissatisfaction was never with the prices charged, but with the lack of transparency.

During the consultation, medications and procedures were performed without the prices being disclosed beforehand and without me being consulted about my agreement. I only found out the prices when it was time to pay.

When I questioned this conduct, the owner replied that there are other clinics geared towards people with more limited financial resources. Besides not answering my question, this statement seemed unnecessary and disrespectful.

Unfortunately, the experience fell far short of what I expected from a clinic that presents itself as premium.
Excellent clinic, affordable, clean.

I would like to register my dissatisfaction with the care provided to my sister Cristina's pet, Ted, by the Paraíso Vet Care clinic.
On April 17th, we took Ted to the clinic in the afternoon. Ted was having the beginning of a seizure and was immediately admitted. Ted was over 15 years old and had several comorbidities, including liver problems, dermatitis, otitis, syndromes, and Cushing's syndrome.
I submitted all of Ted's exams, including an ultrasound, because in November 2025 he had a 3.5 cm tumor. After monitoring and treatment by neurologist Dr. Demetrio, he was started on Gardenal and Prednisolone.
During his hospitalization, Dr. Luana and Dr. Karina were very attentive to Ted and gave him full attention and assistance.
During his hospitalization, he was cared for with great affection.
Ted was discharged the next day and was doing better. He was able to walk, albeit a little unsteady, and was active.
However, returning home and starting the medication, the ALT markers rose from 261 to 1770 and ALP from 188 to 600. We questioned Dr. Demetrio and Dr. Bartira about these changes, and Ted's condition was worsening. We returned to the clinic on the 23rd, and they even performed an abdominal ultrasound, and the tumor had more than doubled in size in 5 months and was 7 cm.
Before, Ted had urinated while being evaluated; it was a bright yellow, almost phosphorescent color. We had never seen Ted's urine that color. But it could probably be a consequence of the medication.
At that moment, Dr. Jaqueline took him to bathe, and Giovani gave Ted a bath, also being very attentive.
After the application of dipyrone and antibiotic, Ted became active and started walking around the room.

We felt insecure regarding the medication treatment, as Ted was on 5 medications at that appointment. And his liver was already overloaded.
That's when we decided to take him to a second clinic in Moema, and they asked us to suspend all medications: Gardenal and Ptednisolone, and all the others that we hadn't started yet, and that
It would be necessary to stabilize all liver markers.
Ted was admitted to the second clinic, they managed to lower the liver markers: ALT from 1770 to 204 and ALP lowered to 400, but unfortunately Ted passed away because he was very weak.
In other words, the treatment at the second clinic was completely the opposite.
They suspended all medications to evaluate a possible surgery to remove the tumor.
In addition to the treatment, there were issues with them charging in advance for 3 blood gas tests without confirming the need for the test. We did not receive confirmation that they were performed, as they would refund the amounts.

Ted did not have anemia, and one of the blood tests showed suspicion, but this may have been due to an error in the collection and analysis of the material, which was only to be done the following day. Even so, a new complete blood count was performed, along with tests for tick markers (460 and 330 each).
These were very high values ​​that were only reported after the tests were performed.
It is indeed up to the professional to verify the real need for all these tests and assess the patient's overall condition. It is unacceptable to have very high expenses when the treatment worsened Ted's condition.
At the second clinic, Ted underwent blood tests and did not present with anemia.
We know that Ted had a

Liver Tumor, but we were unaware of the accelerated growth over 5 months. An ultrasound examination performed at the clinic itself, and the medication prescribed by Paraiso Vet Care, only increased the inflammation and lesion, causing further problems.

Because if the problem was treating the liver tumor, the treatment increasingly raised the liver markers.
The professionals are friendly, but unfortunately we sought the correct and appropriate treatment for our pets.
Since we were vulnerable, we only received the quote at the end, because to save Ted we would do anything.
Totally wrong, ask for quotes before the tests are done.
Our experience was quite negative.
My pet remained calm throughout the entire appointment.
Excellent service, Romário Cavalcante is a great professional and treated us very well, with the utmost dedication.
Dr. Romário's service was outstanding! My two kittens, who were unwell, improved greatly after receiving his affection and care. Thank you so much!!!
Very pleasant environment, with excellent staff. I would also like to thank Dr. Romário Reat Cavalcante for the excellent service and attention he gave us!
Wonderful ❤️
The clinic offers excellent service and infrastructure, not to mention that the professionals are outstanding in every aspect.
I made two calls a short while ago, at 5:58 PM, and they hung up. We informed PET LOVE.

Excellent service from the entire clinic team! Dr. Bartira is an expert in everything she does. Very assertive and careful. Perfect bath with Geovani. We are grateful to everyone for all the care given to our Joey.

Well, the service is good, and there's nothing to complain about regarding the veterinarians. However, regarding the bath and grooming, after we took our dog there and waited, the next day when we left, some small sores started appearing on his skin. He never had anything like that before, and the grooming was very short, almost to the skin. Also, with so many visible places for us to watch, the groomer stayed in a spot where we couldn't see the dog, even though there was space available. But he was far from our sight. We heard a cry that seemed to be his, but we didn't see him or anything like that. Since then, after that bath and grooming, we've already taken him to the vet and given him medication, but the sores and itching haven't improved.
Excellent service! I highly recommend it.
Thank you so much for your review! ❤️
I visited this place on January 1st, 2026, and the service was outstanding, from the reception to Dr. Jaqueline "Jack". It's a fantastic place for your pet. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT! 😍🫶🏻 …

Dr. Karina was extremely attentive and gave me guidance over the phone regarding an emergency I had on a Sunday night. I am immensely grateful and will certainly take my dog ​​there again when needed.

My cat received excellent care from Ana, veterinarian Ester, and Karina. I am very grateful to the doctors for their excellence. The care and attention given to our boy were wonderful. Thank you!! They were very attentive and careful with our pet. I recommend them.
Excellent service from Dr. Sabrina Taha with my Rottweiler, Zoe.

My dog ​​was attacked by a pitbull in the middle of the night, and this clinic treated me very well, showing great care and affection to both my dog ​​and me. The environment was clean, prosperous, and organized. A perfect score!

I highly recommend the clinic. All the professionals, from veterinarians to assistants and receptionists, are wonderful, competent, and very attentive.
In addition to everything else, the team's experience makes me feel safe and at ease. I've never had any problems and have always returned satisfied. I trust them completely! Excellent service, from the veterinary part to the pet shop.
Thank you so much for your feedback! Come back anytime!!
Thank you so much for the care and attention you've given my kitten, Gucci!
Excellent service! My dog ​​received a lot of care and the diagnosis was accurate. The treatment took effect quickly. A trustworthy clinic!
I was very satisfied with the service provided. From reception to post-consultation care, I felt safe and cared for with my pet.

I had a deeply disappointing experience with this clinic when trying to obtain an international health certificate (CVI) for my dog. I specifically chose this clinic after being assured that they would handle the entire process, including coordination with the necessary government authorities. Based on their assurance, I paid for the CVI service and booked international travel for myself and my dog.

Unfortunately, the vet failed to follow through. Although they emailed a few government offices, they did not receive any responses and were not proactive or communicative with me during this crucial time. Just two days before my flight, I was told—without any real assistance—that I would need to go to the government office myself and organize everything on my own. This completely defeated the purpose of the service I paid for.

In the end, I had to reschedule my flight (incurring additional costs), arrange the government appointment myself, and complete the entire process without the vet’s help—aside from a general health certificate, which is only one of several required documents. I requested a refund due to the clinic’s failure to provide the agreed-upon service, but it was denied.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this clinic for CVI-related services or international pet travel. In my experience, they are not reliable or responsive when it matters most.
